[[File:Spice_Triangle.jpg|thumb|250px|The Spice Triangle.]]

The '''Spice Triangle''' was the region of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] delimited by the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]] and the [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]].

It contained worlds particularly involved in the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] trade. The most prominent were [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] and [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Spice Triangle was likely named after the [[Wikipedia:Golden Triangle (Southeast Asia)|Golden Triangle]]: one of the real-world's main opium-producing areas.
